name: Shhh Seattle Fall 2026

venue.name: University of Washington, Spratlen Hall 313
venue.address: 4320 Little Canoe Channel NE, Seattle, WA 98195
venue.details: Enter through the South corner. Room 313 is on the ground floor. Spratlen Hall was recently renamed and may show up as Madrona Hall (the old name) on maps.

information:
This competition is primarily a "PBQ", or "Please Be Quiet" competition. We will be holding blindfolded events, not traditional events like 3x3. As such, this competition is not recommended for first-time competitors, although you are still welcome to sign up. 3BLD, our main event, will have dual rounds, meaning every competitor will be able to participate in two rounds of 3BLD.

You can find other Washington competitions with more standard event lists [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=US&search=Washington).
